name: Noir in Hong Kong
source:
NOIR IN HONG KONG is a Renpy game in which you collect clues and interrogate suspects by trying to catch them in a web of logic and contradictions.  

[From [url=https://liambeale.itch.io/noir-in-hong-kong]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Noir in Hong Kong》是一款Ren'Py游戏。你需要搜集线索、审问嫌疑人，在逻辑与矛盾之间寻找破绽，将他们绳之以法。

[来源：[url=https://liambeale.itch.io/noir-in-hong-kong]Itch.io[/url]]
